info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Rideshare Rides Request-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Request API facilitates the creation of rideshare ride requests, enabling users to initiate ride bookings within the platform. This API serves as a vital component for applications that help connect riders with available drivers in real-time. Typical consumers include mobile app developers and service platforms seeking to enhance transportation solutions. By using this API, businesses can streamline the ride request process, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a new ride request, providing necessary details such as pickup location, destination, and user information. The request will be processed to allocate a driver for the ride.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a ride request. It contains the necessary details such as pickup location, destination, and passenger information. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to process the request successfully.
